comments.author: Teyla
comments.body: In the very northwest point of this map, you can discover a 'Moonbow'. I'm not sure when it occurs, it's not too often, but you can wait for it.

comments.author: sgbg
comments.body:
in the northwest of the map, table boulder:
with procurement r5+2 I got mushrooms, berries, rocks,
with search r7+2 I got lots of rocks, a Straw hat, Afro wig, Dull cutlass, Goat skin tambourine.
